newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta confirms late Canadian debt payment.
newsitem.headline: Alberta confirms late Canadian debt payment.

text.p: The Canadian province of Alberta said it granted a one-month extension to Canadian Airlines Corp for its quarterly loan payment which was due last week, Premier Ralph Klein said.
Canada's federal government also said on Wednesday it had agreed to a one-month delay.
"There's nothing wrong with that, because they (Canadian) have been servicing that loan," Klein said.
Canadian was given a C$50-million restructuring loan guarantee by the Alberta government in 1992 as part of a C$120-million package that was also backstopped by Ottawa and British Columbia.
An Alberta Treasury spokesman said Canadian would pay the interest on the payment, but defer the principal.
Although Canadian has said it did not plan to ask for any more government money or guarantees, Klein has said his government would offer neither anyway.
